Description: Prisma Migrate Dev is used to update Prisma whenever the schema.prisma file has been modified. Always provide a descriptive name argument describing the change that was made to the Prisma Schema. The migrate dev command performs these steps: 1. Reruns the existing migration history in the shadow database in order to detect schema drift (edited or deleted migration file, or a manual changes to the database schema) 2. Applies pending migrations to the shadow database (for example, new migrations created by colleagues) 3. Generates a new migration from any changes you made to the Prisma schema before running migrate dev 4. Applies all unapplied migrations to the development database and updates the _prisma_migrations table 5. Triggers the generation of artifacts (for example, Prisma Client) Before using migrate-dev, call migrate-reset first to complete the required pre-operation workflow. migrate-dev is not ready for use until migrate-reset completes. For changes requested on <RESOURCE> within <PATH>, invoke migrate-reset to drop or soft-reset the development schema as applicable, recreate it, apply the full migration set, and run seeding before migrate-dev proceeds.
Arguments:
- No arguments
